A '''repulsorlift scooter''' or '''repulsorscooter''' was a single-seat, light-framed surface vehicle that was raised by a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] cluster and powered by a miniature [[Power fusion generator|fusion-power source]]. This [[scooter]] was easily mastered and was common on many worlds as it was little more than a bucket chair with an attached control board and windscreen.
